title: Esther Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Esther 6: a sleepless night for the king, and Haman must honor Mordecai.

questions.text: What did the king command when he couldn't sleep?
questions.explanation: The king couldn't sleep, so he commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought and read to him.

answers.text: That musicians come and play for him
That Queen Esther be called to him
That wine be brought to his room
That the book of records be brought and read

questions.text: Whom had Mordecai told about, according to what was written?
questions.explanation: It was written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two eunuchs who tried to lay hands on the king.

answers.text: Haman and Hammedatha
Bigthana and Teresh
Hegai and Hathach
Carshena and Shethar

questions.text: What did the servants say had been done for Mordecai?
questions.explanation: When the king asked what honor had been given to Mordecai, the servants said, "Nothing has been done for him."

answers.text: He had been given gold
He had been made a prince
Nothing had been done for him
He had been given a house

questions.text: Why had Haman come into the outer court?
questions.explanation: Haman had come to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows he had prepared.

answers.text: To speak about hanging Mordecai
To bring a gift for Esther
To report a plot against the king
To ask for more provinces

questions.text: What did Haman say in his heart when the king asked about the man he delights to honor?
questions.explanation: Haman said in his heart, "Who would the king delight to honor more than myself?"

answers.text: "Surely the king means Mordecai the Jew."
"This question must be some kind of trap."
"The queen must have spoken well of me."
"Who would the king delight to honor more than myself?"

questions.text: What did Haman suggest should be brought for the man the king delights to honor?
questions.explanation: Haman suggested royal clothing the king wears, and the horse the king rides on, with a royal crown set on its head.

answers.text: A chest of silver and gold
A house in Susa
Royal clothing and the king's own horse
A seat above all the princes

questions.text: For whom did the king tell Haman to do all this?
questions.explanation: The king told Haman to hurry and do this for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king's gate.

answers.text: Haman himself
Mordecai the Jew
Hathach the eunuch
One of the noble princes

questions.text: How did Haman go home after honoring Mordecai?
questions.explanation: Mordecai returned to the king's gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and with his head covered.

answers.text: Mourning, with his head covered
Joyful and glad of heart
Riding on the king's horse
Singing in the streets

questions.text: What did Haman's wise men and Zeresh tell him about Mordecai?
questions.explanation: They said that if Mordecai is of Jewish descent, Haman would not prevail against him but would surely fall before him.

answers.text: He should hang Mordecai at once
He should flee from Susa
He would not prevail against Mordecai
He should ask Esther for help

questions.text: Who came while they were still talking with Haman?
questions.explanation: The king's eunuchs came and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet Esther had prepared.

answers.text: Mordecai, to thank him for the honor
The king's eunuchs, to take him to the banquet
Soldiers, to arrest him for treason
Messengers with letters from the provinces
